name: Bloom Horror
description: A bloom horror is a large and grotesque flower with dangerous vines that it uses to trap it's prey, slowly pulling it in before finishing it off. This creature is notorious for the deadly poison it's thorns produce and the surprising force of it's bite.

actions.name: Grasping Vines
actions.description: The bloom horror reaches out with it's tendril-like vines and attacks a creature within 3 units, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, a medium or smaller creature also becomes trapped. This vine is destroyed if it takes more than 10 damage in a single turn, inheriting mitigations and defensive checks from the boom horror.

actions.name: Poison Pulse
actions.description: The horror bloom pumps poison through the thorns on it's vines, forcing any creature trapped by it's vines to make a resilience check of 7 or higher or become poisoned for 1 minute, dealing 1d6 damage each turn. If a creature is brought to 0 health by this damage, they fall unconscious and remain poisoned until it is cured.

actions.name: Trip
actions.description: In response to a medium or smaller creature coming taking the move action within 4 units of it, the horror bloom makes a sweeping attack against their legs. If the attack hits a large or smaller creature, the move action ends prematurely. On a true hit, the target also falls prone.

actions.name: Pull
actions.description: The bloom horror pulls a creature it has trapped 1 unit towards it, assuming the tile is unoccupied.

actions.name: Fly Trapper
actions.description: The bloom horror makes a deadly attack against an adjacent creature it has trapped by it's vines, dealing physical damage. A creature who takes more than 10 damage from this attack after mitigations gains 1 tier of the wounded condition.

traits.name: Rooted
traits.description: The bloom horror cannot move unless adjacent to soil.
